items.name: tabs-001
items.title: Вкладки с клавиатурой
items.description: Вкладки, которые слушаются клавиатуры так же, как системные: стрелки переводят выбор, Home и End прыгают к краям. Полоска едет за активной вкладкой.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-tabs-001-*. Разметка следует паттерну tabs из WAI-ARIA: role="tablist", role="tab" с aria-selected и aria-controls, role="tabpanel" с aria-labelledby. В Tab-порядке живёт только активная вкладка (roving tabindex), остальные переключаются стрелками. Полоска под вкладкой — собственный ::after каждой вкладки, ширина берётся от текста, поэтому ничего не измеряется в JS.

ai.usage:
<Tabs001
  items={[
    { id: "overview", label: "Обзор", content: <Overview /> },
    { id: "pages", label: "Страницы", content: <Pages /> },
  ]}
/>
ai.summary: Вкладки с полной клавиатурой: стрелки влево и вправо переводят выбор по кругу, Home и End прыгают к краям, в Tab-порядке остаётся только активная вкладка. Полоска под ней анимируется через transform. Список прокручивается по горизонтали, если вкладок много. Один клиентский компонент, ноль зависимостей, своя палитра.

Компонент клиентский: "use client" нужен ради состояния и клавиатуры.
Не используйте вкладки для навигации между страницами: это переключение содержимого на одной. Для страниц нужны ссылки.

en.description: Tabs that answer the keyboard the way system tabs do: arrows move the selection, Home and End jump to the ends. The underline travels with the active tab.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-tabs-001-* variables. The markup follows the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern: role="tablist", role="tab" with aria-selected and aria-controls, role="tabpanel" with aria-labelledby. Only the active tab lives in the Tab order (a roving tabindex), and the rest are switched with the arrow keys. The bar under a tab is that tab's own ::after and takes its width from the text, so nothing is measured in JS.

ai.summary: Tabs with full keyboard support: left and right arrows move the selection in a loop, Home and End jump to the ends, and only the active tab stays in the Tab order. The underline animates with transform. The list scrolls horizontally when there are many tabs. One client component, zero dependencies, its own palette.

the roving tabindex: 0 on the active tab and -1 on the rest, otherwise Tab walks through every tab
the arrow, Home and End handling together with moving focus: without it the selection changes while focus stays behind
tabIndex={0} on the panel: its content can scroll and has to be reachable from the keyboard
the underline as each tab's own ::after rather than one shared slider positioned from JS
the horizontal scrolling of the list with its hidden scrollbar
the <style> block inside the component — it holds the palette, the layout and the underline animation
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
adapt: the items array: id, label and panel content — content is a ReactNode
defaultId — which tab starts open
the accent through the accent prop — it colours the underline and the focus ring
width and outer spacing through className
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
The component is a client one: "use client" is there for the state and the keyboard handling.
Do not use tabs to navigate between pages: they switch content within one. Pages need links.
Do not hide things that must be compared behind tabs: comparison requires seeing both at once.
Panel ids are built from the tab id. Two instances sharing ids produce duplicate ids in the document — give them different ones.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.

<Tabs001
  items={[
    { id: "overview", label: "Overview", content: <Overview /> },
    { id: "pages", label: "Pages", content: <Pages /> },
  ]}
/>

items.title: Вкладки-пилюли
items.description: Вкладки-пилюли как в системном сегментированном переключателе: активная залита акцентом, между неактивными — тонкие разделители.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-tabs-004-*. Клиентский: "use client" ради выбранной вкладки и клавиатуры. Разделитель — ::before у каждой вкладки, кроме первой; рядом с активной пилюлей он гасится правилами по aria-selected, иначе линия у края заливки выглядит грязью. Разметка следует паттерну tabs из WAI-ARIA, в Tab-порядке живёт только активная вкладка.

en.description: Pill tabs in the manner of a system segmented control: the active pill is filled with the accent, thin dividers separate the rest.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-tabs-004-* variables. A client component: "use client" for the selected tab and for the keyboard. The divider is a ::before on every tab except the first; next to the active pill it is suppressed by rules on aria-selected, otherwise a line at the edge of the fill looks like dirt. The markup follows the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern, and only the active tab lives in the Tab order.

ai.summary: A segmented control built on tabs: pills in a shared track, the active one filled with the accent, neighbours separated by thin lines. Arrows, Home and End move the selection. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette.

the roving tabindex: 0 on the active tab and -1 on the rest

items.title: Вкладки со счётчиками
items.description: Вкладки почтовых папок: значок, подпись и счётчик в одной строке, причём число уходит в имя вкладки, а не читается отдельной цифрой.

en.description: Mail folder tabs: a glyph, a label and a counter in one row, with the number folded into the tab's name rather than read as a bare digit.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-tabs-006-* variables. A client component: "use client" for the selected tab and for the keyboard. The glyphs are drawn with borders and clip-path off the data-glyph attribute, so no icon font is needed. The counter is marked aria-hidden, and the number goes into the tab's aria-label. The markup follows the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern, and the row scrolls horizontally with a hidden scrollbar.

items.title: Прокручиваемые вкладки
items.description: Прокручиваемый ряд вкладок с тенями по краям: тень появляется только с той стороны, где содержимое ещё осталось, и всё это без JS.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-tabs-007-*. Клиентский: "use client" ради выбранной вкладки и клавиатуры, но тени по краям сделаны чистым CSS: четыре градиента с разной привязкой фона — «маска» цвета фона едет вместе с содержимым (background-attachment:local), а сама тень стоит на месте (scroll), поэтому у докрученного края тень закрывается маской. Стрелки дополнительно доводят выбранную вкладку в поле зрения через scrollIntoView.

Подсветка активной ссылки собирается из идентификаторов панелей и вставляется вторым тегом style с ключом по их набору.

Идентификаторы панелей попадают и в адрес, и в CSS-селекторы: делайте их уникальными на странице и без пробелов.

en.title: Tabs In The URL
en.description: Anchor-driven switching: the open tab lands in the address, the link can be shared and Back returns the previous one.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-tabs-011-* variables. Server component: the tabs are plain anchor links and the active panel is chosen through :target. While the address carries no hash, the first panel shows. The active-link highlight is assembled from the panel ids and injected as a second style tag keyed by that set.

ai.summary: Anchor tabs: the state lives in the address, so a link opens the right tab and the Back button behaves as expected.
preserve: the local --vibeui-tabs-011-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the state in the address: that is what separates this from ordinary tabs
showing the first panel while the address has no hash — otherwise the page looks empty
links instead of buttons: only those can be copied and opened in a new tab
the underline on the active tab rather than colour alone
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
adapt: the panels and their ids through panels
the strip label for screen readers through groupLabel
the note under the panel through hint
accent — the active tab underline colour
background — the component surface; empty means the built-in palette
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
Panel ids end up both in the address and in CSS selectors: keep them unique on the page and free of spaces.
Following an anchor scrolls the page to the panel. If that gets in the way, add scroll-margin-top to the block or intercept the navigation in your router.
With several such blocks on a page the ids must differ: there is only one address.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.

items.title: Вкладки-значки
items.description: Узкая полоса без подписей: имя вкладки не исчезает, а живёт в подсказке и метке для скринридера.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-tabs-012-*. Клиентский. Стрелки, Home и End ходят по вкладкам и переносят фокус, как ожидается от tablist. Значок собран из двух букв, поэтому иконочный пакет не нужен; подпись уходит в aria-label и title, а переключателем возвращается на полосу целиком. Активная вкладка помечена заливкой, а не только цветом текста.

en.title: Icon Tabs
en.description: A narrow strip without captions: the tab name does not disappear but lives in the tooltip and the screen-reader label.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-tabs-012-* variables. Client component. Arrows, Home and End walk the tabs and move focus as expected from a tablist. The mark is two letters, so no icon package is needed; the caption goes into aria-label and title and a toggle brings it back onto the strip. The active tab is marked by a fill rather than by text colour alone.

ai.summary: A compact icon tab strip: the caption sits in aria-label and the tooltip, a toggle brings the text back, and the keyboard walks with arrows.
preserve: the local --vibeui-tabs-012-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the caption in aria-label and title: a mark without a name is not read by everyone
the fill on the active tab — colour alone survives neither print nor colour blindness
arrows, Home and End: without them a tablist is unreachable from the keyboard
tabIndex −1 on inactive tabs — Tab must not walk the whole strip
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own

showing captions on the strip through withLabels
the strip label through groupLabel

background — the component surface; empty means the built-in palette
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
The mark is two letters, not an icon: an icon package is not worth a strip of three buttons. Pass your own icon through mark if you have one.
title only appears on mouse hover: it duplicates aria-label rather than replacing it.
There is one panel here and it swaps content. For heavy panels keep them mounted and toggle visibility instead.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.

items.name: tabs-013
items.title: Загрузка панели
items.description: Панель вкладки приходит с сервера: на время паузы стоит скелетон, отказ назван словом и снабжён повтором.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-tabs-013-*. Клиентский. Состояние каждой панели хранится отдельно, поэтому уже загруженная вкладка открывается сразу. Скелетон повторяет форму будущего текста, панель несёт aria-busy, а ошибка выводится с role=alert и кнопкой повтора. Полоса вкладок не блокируется на время загрузки.

en.title: Panel Loading
en.description: The tab panel arrives from the server: a skeleton fills the pause, and a failure is named and given a retry.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-tabs-013-* variables. Client component. Each panel keeps its own state, so an already loaded tab opens instantly. The skeleton repeats the shape of the future text, the panel carries aria-busy, and the error is announced with role=alert next to a retry button. The tab strip is never blocked while loading.

ai.summary: Tabs with a loading panel: a skeleton instead of emptiness, a waiting dot on the tab itself, a failure with retry and a strip that stays usable.
preserve: the local --vibeui-tabs-013-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the skeleton shaped like the future text — otherwise the layout jumps when data lands
aria-busy on the panel: waiting has to be audible, not only visible
role=alert on the failure and the retry button next to it
the unblocked strip: leaving a slow tab must always be possible
per-tab state memory — a loaded panel must not reload
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
adapt: the tabs, their texts and delays
the captions through loadingText, errorText and retryLabel
the open tab through currentId
accent — the underline and waiting-dot colour
background — the component surface; empty means the built-in palette
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
delay and fails exist for the demo: in production the state comes from a request, not a timer.
Retry resets only the current tab: neighbouring loaded panels stay as they are.
The dot stops pulsing under prefers-reduced-motion — it stays visible but still.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.
